description.value:
You send a jolt of electricity into a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d8 lightning damage, and if it is a droid, construct, or carries a tech focus, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the end of your next turn.

This power's damage increases to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
